name: PR1ME Jelly Theme
overview: Glass UI theme for Jellyfin: top bar, rows, details page and login page.
description: A premium glass look for the Jellyfin web UI and the official mobile apps. Frosted top bar, refined rows and cards, a bigger details-page backdrop with cleaner metadata, a styled login page, and a dashboard page for accent colour and per-module toggles. Style only: it never touches playback and leaves other plugins alone. Requires the File Transformation plugin.
